chosen.label: AwardWinEvent
chosen.definition: An event where an individual or entity receives an award.
chosen.justification: No schema.org candidate specifically describes an 'Award Win' event. Minting 'AwardWinEvent' as a new type under 'Event' is the most appropriate.

candidates.label: TheaterEvent
candidates.comment: An event representing a live performance in a theater. Also called stage play, theatrical show, drama performance. Examples: a Broadway musical, a local community play, a Shakespearean tragedy.

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: LiteraryEvent
candidates.comment: An event focused on literature, such as readings, book launches, or discussions. Also called book event, author appearance, literary gathering. Examples: a poetry reading, a book signing, a literary festival, a panel discussion with authors.

candidates.label: SportsEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving athletic competition or display. Also called athletic contest, game, match, sporting competition. Examples: a football game, an Olympic event, a marathon race, a tennis tournament.

candidates.label: PerformingArtsEvent
candidates.comment: A PerformingArtsEvent is an event featuring live performances of arts like music, theatre, dance, or acrobatics. Also called live performance, show, stage event. Examples: a Broadway play, a ballet performance, a circus show, a stand-up comedy act. Distinct from MusicEvent, which is specifically for music.

chosen.label: CommendationEvent
chosen.definition: An event where praise or formal recognition is given to an individual or entity.
chosen.justification: No schema.org candidate specifically describes a 'Commendation' event; 'UserInteraction' types are outdated and too specific. Minting 'CommendationEvent' under 'Event' is the best fit.

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: UserComments
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of posting comments or feedback. Also called user comment, public comment, feedback post. Examples: a user leaving a comment on a blog post, posting a review, providing feedback on a product.

candidates.label: UserLikes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of expressing approval or liking for content. Also called user like, content like, approval. Examples: a user liking a photo on social media, giving a thumbs-up to a video, favoriting an item.

candidates.label: UserCheckins
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of checking into a location or event. Also called user check-in, location check-in, event attendance. Examples: a user checking into a restaurant, checking into a concert, marking attendance at a conference.

candidates.label: CourseInstance
candidates.comment: A CourseInstance is a specific offering of an educational course, distinguished by its particular time, location, medium, or target student group. Also called course section, class session, course offering, specific class. Examples: "Fall 2023 Introduction to Python (Online)," "Spring 2024 Art History 101 (Campus A, Section B)," "Summer Intensive Yoga Teacher Training." Distinct from Course, which is the general description of the educational content.

chosen.justification: Schema.org's 'PerformingArtsEvent' is a suitable match for 'Performance', as it covers live performances in arts like film, fitting the examples of film roles and performances.

candidates.label: ScreeningEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving the public showing of a movie or other video content. Also called film screening, movie showing, video presentation, cinema event. Examples: a film festival screening, a premiere showing of a new movie, a public documentary viewing, a drive-in movie night.

candidates.label: ComedyEvent
candidates.comment: An event featuring comedic performances or content. Also called stand-up show, humor performance, comedy festival. Examples: A stand-up comedy show, a sketch comedy performance, a comedy festival, an improv night. Distinct from Event, which is a general occurrence.

chosen.label: PerformancePeriodEvent
chosen.definition: An event representing a period of time during which an individual or entity engaged in performances.
chosen.justification: No schema.org candidate represents a 'Performance Period' as an event, as existing event types are for single occurrences. Minting 'PerformancePeriodEvent' under 'Event' is the best fit.

candidates.label: MusicEvent
candidates.comment: A MusicEvent is an event primarily featuring musical performances. Also called concert, musical performance, gig. Examples: a rock concert, a classical symphony performance, a music festival. Distinct from PerformingArtsEvent, which includes broader performance types like theatre or dance.

chosen.label: DisclosureEvent
chosen.definition: An event where information, often previously private or sensitive, is revealed or made known.
chosen.justification: No schema.org candidate specifically describes a 'Disclosure' event; 'PublicationEvent' is too narrow. Minting 'DisclosureEvent' under 'Event' is the most appropriate.

candidates.label: BroadcastEvent
candidates.comment: A BroadcastEvent is a PublicationEvent representing an event that is transmitted over the air or online. Also called live broadcast, streamed event, televised event, radio broadcast. Examples: a live news report, a sports game broadcast, a concert livestream.

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: OnDemandEvent
candidates.comment: An OnDemandEvent, as a PublicationEvent, is a publication event where a program is available on-demand. Also called catch-up TV, podcast release, streaming event. Examples: a TV show episode available for streaming after broadcast, a podcast episode release, a movie available for rent online. Distinct from BroadcastEvent, which is a live or scheduled transmission.

candidates.label: PublicationEvent
candidates.comment: A PublicationEvent is an Event corresponding to the publication of a CreativeWork, regardless of its type or delivery medium. Also called release event, publishing event. Examples: the release of a new book, the broadcast of a TV show, the online publication of an article, the launch of a new album.
